duplicate_findings: sfind-49728a99fc644ef1b6eb34b07fef5de8; sfind-26befe282e82415fa22f0a2c4b951d46; sfind-8e211180972c483791bf198517421c86; sfind-7cc6bb1419c04cefaa63ec4acf5a3ef7; sfind-7c727129093245ecb173c491301989be; sfind-e4b9785ac3214b8d91e1e90c99ce728e; sfind-6b9a0d298dac4eb1a29bc78614163a87; sfind-f7f4adf7ccae4e9096f1d7ceee26e3d9; sfind-22d267ce2c4342278086b0d487c0518e; sfind-4c32d871862f401f9649464029e813c7; sfind-aa7b37083afc4ace99fbdb71081b5f52
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: One mechanical fix across files: no literals or defaults, fail closed at startup if unset, manifest reads a Kubernetes Secret mounted as a file (V-242415 forbids secrets as env vars). Coordinate with U08 (export authZ, same lines in settings.py/main.py) and U16 (same manifest, different hunk).

title: Passwords stored as unsalted MD5 (auth.hash_password)
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (FIPS-approved algorithm); DB is in-memory and re-seeded so no migration and no user-visible change. sfind-e7836101 secondary CWE-613 (tokens never expire) is remediated in U09. FIPS-validated module itself is POA&M U20.

title: Fixable dependency CVEs: starlette 0.41.3 (via fastapi 0.115.6), pytest 8.3.4, pip 25.0.1
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: SBOM (grype+trivy, source and image) database matches, reachability not assessed. Bump fastapi to a release that allows starlette>=1.3.1 (highest fix version), pytest>=9.0.3, upgrade pip>=26.2.0 in the image; keep test-only deps out of the runtime image (CM-7). If the starlette 1.x bump changes API behavior, the child stops and reports. SBOM IDs are not on the Findings page (no dismissal).

title: Images not digest-pinned (mrt:latest in manifest, python:3.12-slim base by tag)
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Pin base image by the digest recorded in the baseline SBOM provenance and the mrt image by digest (build pipeline supplies it). No runtime behavior change. CM-5(6)/SR-4 are outside the OSCAL High baseline (ISSO to tailor in). Coordinate with U16 (same manifest) and U05 (Dockerfile).

owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Add security regression tests (each remediation PR also adds its own). Adding a CI workflow is a new security gate: per guardrails it needs an explicit human OK in-session before Devin adds it.

owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Export requires an authenticated user with an export role; API-key callers break. Depends on U12 (PKI/IdP identity). Coordinate with U03 (same settings lines).

title: No idle session timeout, token expiry or logout/revocation
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: ISSM values: 15 min idle; users are logged out after idle; adds /logout. Also closes the CWE-613 secondary of sfind-e7836101 (U04).

title: No unsuccessful-logon limit or account lockout
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: ISSM values: 3 attempts / 15 min lockout. sfind-3f4588d0 (primary CWE-307) also cites CWE-598 (password in URL, fixed by U13) and CWE-117 (log forging, fixed by U11). Same login() as U13 and U15: run them in sequence or as one child.

title: Audit records lack actor, source IP, UTC time, outcome; export/token/404/500 events unaudited; CUI identifiers in logs
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Audit schema change (structured record with ISSM fields: actor, action, object, source IP, UTC time, outcome); downstream log consumers see a new format. Covers log-injection (CWE-117) from sfind-3f4588d0 and asset-name-in-log (sfind-77fe55fe, ISSM to confirm whether identifiers are CUI).

title: Local username/password login instead of DoD PKI/CAC via IdP
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: App-side OIDC integration with the inherited Keycloak/DoD PKI IdP (00-boundary.md: IdP inherited, IA-2(x) code-owned). Login flow changes for every user. Needs IdP client config from the platform team. Canonical is the SRG finding still Open; its siblings were already dismissed by the SRG scan triage.

title: Password accepted as URL query parameter on POST /login
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Credentials move to the request body; clients sending query parameters break. Same function as U10; superseded if U12 removes local passwords.

title: No DoD Notice and Consent Banner before authentication
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Standard DoD banner text (ISSM value) with acknowledgement before login; user-visible.

title: Seeded default account with weak password; no password length/age/history policy
owner: Devin remediation child; dev lead Achal Amin reviews
justification: Remove the literal operator/Password1 seed (provision from a Secret or IdP) and enforce ISSM password policy (15 chars, 60-day max age, 24 history). Login for the demo account changes. Superseded in part if U12 removes local passwords.

justification: Non-root USER, runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, drop ALL caps, no privilege escalation, resource limits; operator-visible runtime change. Namespace PSA label / admission config is platform evidence. sfind-9c145066 also cites V-242415/V-274883 (secrets, U03). Coordinate with U03/U05/U06 (same files).
